description: umweltkarten-niedersachsen.de: heat hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltkarten-niedersachsen.de. Coverage: the area served by umweltkarten-niedersachsen.de. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about heat hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Rasterdaten der beobachteten und projizierten Hitzetage für Niedersach; Rasterdaten der beobachteten und projizierten Hitzeperioden von mindes; Rasterdaten der beobachteten und projizierten maximalen Hitzeperiode f. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
